summary: A CDC-powered pipeline with no message broker — Conduit streams PostgreSQL logical replication changes to a plain JSONL bridge file, and Bento tails the file, joins actors, and indexes enriched documents into Elasticsearch. Deletes propagate, stale documents are gone.

A CDC-powered evolution of the Camel K ETL pipeline — replacing H2 polling with PostgreSQL logical replication and Debezium, with a Groovy processor that handles creates, updates, and deletes natively. Stale documents are a thing of the past.

A practical end-to-end demonstration of Apache Camel K on Kubernetes, using separate vintage-styled Kamelets for two H2 databases and a Groovy-powered join processor to index joined movie-actor documents into Elasticsearch.
Extend the automation from Automating Maven Releases with GitHub Actions with a trunk-based branching model — major/minor releases from main, patch releases from release branches, all automated.
Automate the release process from Understanding Maven's Release Lifecycle — deploy SNAPSHOTs on every push and cut releases with a single button click.
Build a native Java microservice using GraalVM and Quarkus with a multi-stage Dockerfile — no local GraalVM installation required.

"OKF is an open, vendor-neutral specification for representing knowledge as a directory of markdown files with YAML frontmatter—designed to be authored by people, generated by agents, and consumed by both."
A proof-of-concept streaming tokenizer that processes arbitrarily large inputs using just 9KB of memory, achieving 5x speedup over bash baseline.
"How OpenID Connect is being extended to authenticate, authorize, and delegate credentials for autonomous AI agents—and what a real credential exchange looks like."
A deep dive into implementing binary protocol parsing, Patricia trie traversal, and async I/O in Zig—no external dependencies.
Why your dev/QA/staging environments turn into a group project and how to fix it.
Running Elasticsearch with SQL support in Docker for quick local development and testing.
Breaking free from Spring annotations in your core business logic using explicit bean registration.
Setting up free Tailscale VPN to connect your iPhone and Mac without paying for a server.
GGUF, the binary format powering local LLM inference, and how quantization makes AI accessible on consumer hardware.
Calling Zig compiled libraries from Java using JNR-FFI, without writing any JNI code.
Introduction to SIMD operations in Zig using vector types, with practical examples for numerical computing and image processing.
Computing sentence embeddings with MiniLM-L6-v2 in pure Zig using ONNX Runtime, without Python.
Understanding Maven's release process and how to properly version your Java projects.
How to build and run the latest Zig compiler from source inside a Docker container.
